resources.string: Tap Start protection to block dangerous sites and ads for every app, on any network.
Dangerous sites and ads are blocked for every app.
Block list: AdGuard DNS filter, %1$s names
Address blocking isn\'t active. The app downloads the lists when the phone is online.
%1$s: paused, last downloaded %2$s. Old lists can block addresses that others use now.
The app needs Android\'s VPN permission to see DNS lookups. It is used only on the phone, and there is no Cocode server: lookups that are not blocked go to the network\'s own DNS server, as before.
Android stopped protection, for example because another VPN app took over or the VPN was turned off in settings. DNS lookups are no longer filtered.

\"Block connections without VPN\" is on. The app sends only DNS lookups and connections to known-bad addresses through its tunnel, so with that setting the phone can\'t reach the internet at all. Turn the setting off in VPN settings, then start again.
Something went wrong. DNS lookups are no longer filtered.
Android keeps protection on. Turn off Always-on VPN in VPN settings to be able to stop it.
Protection can\'t run with Private DNS

Private DNS is set to a specific server. With that setting the phone can\'t reach the internet at all while protection runs, so it has stopped. DNS lookups are not filtered. Turn Private DNS off or choose Automatic under Network and internet, then start again.
The app can\'t tell you if protection stops.
Only DNS lookups and connections to known-bad addresses pass through the app. No server, no account. Apps with their own secure DNS bypass the name filter.
An app tried to connect to %1$s, which is on the %2$s list. The connection was refused.
Dangerous sites and ads are blocked.
